Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner supplied an incorrect IMDb URL/id for Gamer, directing WebSurfer to https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0479952/ (which is Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa) instead of the correct Gamer title page (tt1034032). This ID mismatch led to opening the wrong film page and subsequent misnavigation/timeouts, reflecting inadequate verification of the IMDb link.
